title: PRD-22 synthetic risk input syntax

patientRef.description: required; patient/guardian authority for health purpose. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: PATIENT_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

treatmentCode.description: required; contract-approved category <= 80. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: TREATMENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

providerRef.description: required; approved provider/network revision. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PROVIDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

deviceModelCode.description: conditional by contract; approved device category <= 80. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: DEVICE_NOT_ELIGIBLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

treatmentDate.description: conditional before acceptance; explicit proposed/performed status. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: TREATMENT_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

clinicalEvidenceRef.description: conditional for underwriting; purpose-scoped evidence, restricted review. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: CLINICAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

benefitPlanCode.description: required; approved benefit/exclusion version. Sensitivity: internal. Error: BENEFIT_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
